label: MacBook Pro 14-inch (M3)
description: 14.2-inch pro laptop, Apple M3, HDMI plus SDXC and two Thunderbolt 4 ports; Wi-Fi 6E.
notes: No RJ45: Apple ships HDMI, SDXC and Thunderbolt 4 but no wired Ethernet. A USB-C dock/dongle provides 1GbE (2.5GbE with a 2.5G adapter); out of the box this host is Wi-Fi 6E only.
